metadata.title: Empirical Lawhood
metadata.description: How can reliable scientific capabilities accumulate when the conditions needed to acquire and use knowledge must themselves be discovered or constructed? Motivated by dependable fusion propulsion for a journey to Neptune, Empirical Lawhood investigates how knowledge can help establish the means of further discovery and action. Kant’s inquiry into warrant, Wheeler’s observer-participancy and Gell-Mann and Hartle’s physical account of regularity ground an investigation in which observers, instruments and the conditions of inquiry belong to the world being investigated. The framework is developed and applied through human-directed scientific discovery and prospective tests of particular constructions. Analytical and numerical resistor–capacitor studies expose consequential distinctions omitted by reduced observations. Matrix investigations separate geometric organisation from dynamical commitment, an approximate algebra from its scalar detector, and accurate intervention-induced changes from uncertain absolute futures. Two prospective constructions then establish different connections. A forecast supplies the input to fixed response coefficients, supporting both requested assays in 61 of 64 fresh episodes after separate calibration of the composition. A selected preparation makes an entirely unchanged response package usable on 7,965 of 8,192 request pairs across 32 fresh local episodes, versus none under unchanged preparation; a conservative numerical check retains 6,720 pairs. The dominant gain is qualified applicability, not newly attainable response. Further simulations and physical records locate limits of information, uncertainty, delivery and transfer. These findings are scientific outputs of the inquiry, not only tests of a general framework. They support a programme for cumulative capability: a civilisational response-law engine whose missing prerequisites become explicit scientific targets. A further aim is to broaden scientific agency—people's capacity to choose and redirect inquiry—without making autonomous agenda-setting a condition of using automated capabilities.
